title: Canadian Beef Skewers
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring marinated Canadian beef, grilled to perfection. Serve with your favorite sides for a delicious meal.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper.
2. Add the Canadian beef cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
5. Thread the marinated beef onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Brush the skewers with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
7. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
8. Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
